title: LegacyReportRepository
responsibility: Reads the legacy report store without writing to it.

inputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.constructor.store
inputs.description: Filesystem path to the root of the legacy report store. The repository resolves its runs directory and run asset directories from this path.

inputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.asset.run
inputs.description: Run directory name used as the run path segment when resolving an asset. It is not checked against the directory names returned by runs().

inputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.asset.file
inputs.description: Path passed to resolve beneath the selected run's assets directory. A resolved path that fails the assets-directory prefix check, or a failed file read, returns undefined.

outputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.runs
outputs.description: Array of run records for direct subdirectories of the runs directory whose UTF-8 manifest.json parses as JSON, sorted lexicographically by directory name. Missing or unreadable manifests and invalid JSON are skipped; a failed directory listing yields an empty array, and a manifest may be any JSON value.

outputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.asset
outputs.description: Bytes read from the requested asset, or undefined when the resolved path fails the assets-directory prefix check or the file read rejects. The repository does not parse or interpret the bytes.

outputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.runs
outputs.description: Array of run records for direct subdirectories of the runs directory whose UTF-8 manifest.json parses as JSON, sorted lexicographically by directory name. Missing or unreadable manifests and invalid JSON are skipped; a failed directory listing yields an empty array, and a manifest may be any JSON value.

inputs.description: Path passed to resolve beneath the selected run's assets directory. A resolved path that fails the assets-directory prefix check, or a failed file read, returns undefined.

outputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.asset
outputs.description: Bytes read from the requested asset, or undefined when the resolved path fails the assets-directory prefix check or the file read rejects. The repository does not parse or interpret the bytes.

inputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.constructor.store
inputs.description: Filesystem path to the root of the legacy report store. The repository resolves its runs directory and run asset directories from this path.

outputs.name: LegacyReportRepository.constructor
outputs.description: The constructed repository instance retains the supplied store path. Construction performs no filesystem access; reads occur when runs() or asset() is called.
